title: ISO 42001 Compliance Manager
description: WHAT IS BOX?   Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. WHY BOX NEEDS YOU  We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance manager who is looking to put their auditing experience, technical expertise, and information security knowledge to plan, execute and deliver on existing and strategic new Compliance certifications focused on International Organization for Standardizations (ISO).  As our Compliance manager, you will play a key role to build a scalable and efficient program and process related to the Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS) (ISO 42001) and AI governance within Box. You will work with all functions of this fast-paced, rapidly changing business, and directly with key stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, communication and education with Box's internal customers.  The right person be excellent at communicating vertically and horizontally across the company and will be comfortable explaining Box's compliance posture internally and externally, working cross-functionally and providing technical and creative guidance to technical teams. WHAT YOU'LL DO  Drive and Lead Box’s annual ISO Certification program for AIMS against ISO 42001 Create and own the AIMS program and assess AI Governance effectiveness while working with internal teams Execute external audits with third-party auditors and maintain relationships Work across multiple frameworks and regulatory standards, including but not limited to ISO, PCI, NIST, AICPA SOC Drive improvements in existing processes and develop new innovative and efficient solutions Communicate gaps to management and coordinate cross functional team meetings to remediate and close the control gaps Monitor and identify compliance issues and follow-up Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders Accurately and effectively communicate our compliance position and programs internally and externally WHO YOU ARE  Required Skills: 4+ years experience leading and performing ISO 27001 audits or in an equivalent technology and compliance related role managing security audits Familiar with GCP cloud computing, AI architectures, Data governance and model validations Certified in security and compliance certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CIA, and CISM Ability to effectively communicate complex requirements to non-technical and technical stakeholders Extensive knowledge of at least 2 or more of the following compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 42001, PCI, SOC, NIST 800-53) BS degree in Business or Management Information Systems or related field OR equivalent work experience Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills Willingness to wear different hats and work on areas where needed Amazing organizational skills with a drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment Ability to hustle, get stuff done, and has strong integrity - make mom proud! Preferred skills ISO 27001 Lead Implementer certification and ISO 42001 Lead Auditor certification  Big 4 Experience or Management Consulting Experience Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process. At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply! title: Associate Director, Information Governance and Data Compliance
description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 12 Director, Information Governance and Data Compliance The Team: The Data Privacy, Protection and Governance team at S&P Global is dedicated to managing sensitive, personal, and non-personal information. We achieve this through the implementation of comprehensive policies, processes, controls, and metrics that ensure compliance with global regulations. The Impact: S&P Global is seeking a Director, Information Governance and Data Compliance to lead and enhance enterprise-wide information governance and data compliance capabilities across its global data and analytics business. This role is responsible for developing, operationalizing, and enforcing policies, standards, and controls governing the lifecycle of business information and personal data. The Director will ensure alignment with S&P Global’s Privacy Program, Information Governance Policy framework, and evolving regulatory obligations across jurisdictions. The position plays a critical leadership role in embedding privacy by design, strengthening data classification compliance, and operationalizing a risk-based data governance model that supports S&P Global’s delivery of data-driven products and services, including analytics, ratings, market intelligence, and entity-based data solutions. S&P Global’s business model—focused on delivering data, analytics, and insight to global markets—requires robust governance over data sourcing, processing, retention, and usage to ensure trust, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience. What’s in it for you: In this role, you will: Collaborate with senior and executive stakeholders globally. Act as a senior advisor to stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Technology, and business divisions. Lead cross-functional governance forums to drive alignment and accountability for data governance activities. Be an integral part of enhancing and developing the global Data Compliance program, working alongside executive leadership to drive our team forward. Responsibilities: The Director, Information Governance and Data Compliance will be responsible for: Information Governance & Policy Leadership Lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise Information Governance frameworks covering data lifecycle management (creation, use, retention, and disposal). Own and maintain core policies and standards, including: Information Governance Policy Information Classification Standard Records Retention Schedule Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, internal risk frameworks, and international standards. Data Classification & Information Handling Establish and oversee enterprise-wide data classification frameworks and compliance monitoring. Partner with Information Security and technology teams to ensure appropriate controls for data access, storage, and protection. Implement and track metrics to measure classification compliance and data handling effectiveness. Enterprise Data Governance Drive development of a scalable, enterprise data governance model , including: Data inventory and cataloging Data ownership and stewardship Data flow visibility and control Collaborate with business, technology, and risk teams to ensure governance controls are embedded across products, platforms, and operations. Privacy by Design & Compliance Integration Embed privacy by design and default principles into business processes, systems, and product development. Support execution of S&P Global’s Global Privacy Program and related controls governing lawful, fair, and proportionate processing of personal information. Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to ensure alignment on regulatory obligations across jurisdictions. Other Privacy projects, as assigned. Risk Management & Regulatory Readiness Identify, assess, and mitigate risks relating to data governance, retention, classification, and regulatory compliance. Support internal audits, regulatory inquiries, and external assessments. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence of compliance. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance and Oversight Act as Data Compliance support for the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of S&P Global’s AI governance framework, ensuring the responsible, ethical, and compliant use of artificial intelligence and automated decision-making technologies across the enterprise. Where necessary, establish and oversee policies, standards, controls, and risk assessment processes governing the lifecycle of AI systems, including model development, procurement, deployment, monitoring, and retirement. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Technology, Risk, and business stakeholders to ensure AI initiatives align with regulatory requirements, corporate policies, data governance standards, and responsible AI principles, while promoting transparency, accountability, and effective risk management. title: Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed. The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests. This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed. What You’ll Do Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions. Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs. Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes. Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required. Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays. Support the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks and legal processes, and develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote best practices and understanding of legal risks, contracting principles and company processes. Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture. What You’ll Bring Qualified lawyer with significant (10-15+ years) post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department but including significant in-house experience. Strong commercial contracts background, ideally within a software, SaaS, cloud technology or broader technology company. Excellent drafting, contract review and negotiation skills. Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements. Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner. Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment. Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data. Bonus Skills Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk proportionately. Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive discussions to achieve the best outcome for the business. Proactive, self-motivated and willing to take ownership of complex matters from start to finish. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of matters and conflicting priorities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts, articulate recommendations and options, and deliver practical advice that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders. Sound judgement and the confidence to make risk-based decisions in situations where there may not be a clear precedent or established playbook.
